featured_reviews.name: Rupesh Shigvan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very bad experience with this shop. Before buying, they tell one price, but after payment they ask for extra money. This feels completely fraudulent.

I purchased an AC for ₹26,500 and was only given a challan instead of the original GST bill. After making the full cash payment, they suddenly demanded ₹2,500 extra, saying the price had increased. This is unacceptable and misleading behavior.

The staff behavior was also very rude and unprofessional. They do not respond properly to customer complaints.

I also bought a cooler from them, but they gave me a sample/display piece without informing me. Within just 2 days, the cooler started leaking water. When I complained about the issue, they completely ignored me.

I would strongly advise others to be careful before purchasing anything from this shop. Please make sure to get a proper GST bill and check the product carefully before payment.

featured_reviews.name: bhavik rathod
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointed with Reliance Digital.

I purchased an AC from Reliance Digital and also paid an extra ₹4,500 for their 5-year service plan, expecting better support and peace of mind. Unfortunately, my experience has been terrible.

The first AC delivered to me was damaged. After waiting about a week, it was finally replaced. However, within a week of installation, water started leaking from the indoor split unit. The service team visited after 3–4 days, checked the piping, and assured me that the issue was fixed. Sadly, the same problem happened again within a week.

Another service visit was arranged, and the issue was supposedly resolved. But now, after just 2 months, the same water leakage problem has returned again.

I paid extra for the service plan expecting reliable support, but instead I have faced repeated problems, multiple service visits, delays, and inconvenience. Based on my personal experience, I would not recommend purchasing the extended service plan from Reliance Digital.

I am extremely disappointed with both the product support and after-sales service. I would suggest considering other retailers such as Croma or Vijay Sales, where hopefully customers receive better service and support. :::

(1/5)

featured_reviews.name: Nilesh Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst Experience with Kohinoor
People visit Kohinoor showrooms to get proper product guidance and make informed purchases. Unfortunately, I had a very disappointing experience with Mr. Jagannath, a salesperson at your showroom.
We purchased an LG washing machine based on Mr. Jagannath's recommendation. He specifically advised us not to buy a front-load washing machine and suggested a top-load machine, stating that it would work better in areas with low water pressure and where bucket filling is commonly used.
Trusting his advice, we purchased the top-load washing machine. However, within a month, the machine started facing operational issues.
I contacted Kohinoor, and a technician visited after two days. After inspection, he informed us that the machine was not functioning properly because of low water pressure and advised us to install a water pressure booster pump, which would cost approximately ₹4,000–₹5,000.
I then visited the Kohinoor showroom to raise this concern. Mr. Jagannath was absent, but the showroom manager and other sales staff also advised me to purchase a booster pump.
My question is: If low water pressure was already a known issue, why was I advised to purchase this machine in the first place? The guidance provided by your salesperson was incorrect and misleading. Because of this wrong recommendation, I have ended up purchasing a product that does not suit my requirements and am now being asked to spend an additional ₹4,000–₹5,000.
Who will bear this extra cost?
Customers visit Kohinoor expecting accurate product information and professional guidance. Receiving incorrect advice defeats the purpose of seeking assistance from your sales team.
Therefore, I request Kohinoor to take responsibility for the misinformation provided and reimburse the cost of the booster pump installation, estimated at ₹5,000.
I look forward to a fair resolution of this matter at the earliest.
